summary: NOVA LTD. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release titled 'Nova WMC Expanding Adoption Across the Most Advanced Packaging Processes.' The release announces a customer selection of its Nova WMC platform by a leading global foundry for advanced packaging metrology, along with broader adoption trends. No financial terms, transaction structure, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine business development update and product adoption press release, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or any other event listed in the special-situations taxonomy.
